method: Manual thematic primary clusters from judge explanations. Additional tags are lexical indicators, not independently validated defects. One primary cluster per failure; passes retained separately.

clusters.label: Answer or exact recipe
clusters.description: The prompt gives the answer or an explicit recipe, such as "run these commands with these flags" or "set these parameters to these values." The agent mainly needs to carry out the specified changes.

clusters.label: Approach hints
clusters.description: The judge says the prompt suggests or prescribes implementation choices, such as a tool, algorithm, or technique, while leaving the agent to write the implementation. A numbered list of required functionality alone is a specification, not an approach hint.

clusters.label: Environment inventory
clusters.description: The judge objects to listing installed libraries, hardware, directory contents, fixtures, or other details it expects the agent to discover.

clusters.label: Procedural checklists
clusters.description: The judge criticizes the prompt for listing steps or a detailed checklist of requirements.

clusters.label: Missing or unclear requirements
clusters.description: The explanation reports vague goals or missing paths, inputs, schemas, argument formats, or requirements that the tests depend on.

clusters.label: Incorrect or contradictory context
clusters.description: The explanation reports inaccurate environment descriptions, inconsistent requirements, or misleading factual statements.

clusters.label: Style and wordiness
clusters.description: The explanation focuses on roleplay, headings, repetition, verbosity, basic explanations, or perceived LLM style. Some also complain about resolvable relative paths.

tag_patterns.procedural_steps: step.by.step|procedure|procedural|process directive|process steps|steps to|what steps|lists the steps|sub-steps
tag_patterns.solution_or_approach_guidance: hint|solution|approach|prescrib|dictat|exact (?:command|fix|answer|directive|selector)|root cause|recommended values|spoon.feed|hand.hold|hand.holds|hands (?:out|over)|tells the agent which|names the tools|tool to use|tools to use|suggests algorithms|suggests specific|process directives
tag_patterns.environment_or_fixture_listing: environment|available|pre.?installed|fixture|file contents|contents of|directory contents|tree listing|table list|dataset schema|dataset column|structure description|lists every input|template already provides
tag_patterns.path_complaint: relative|no target files|no output path|neither the script path|output location|location of the new keys
